user.title: Connect to Denon App Volume
user.description: Enter the ESP32 host and choose the Apple TV to follow. If the ESP32 joined Wi-Fi more than ten minutes ago, restart it and submit within ten minutes.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Set up {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Choose the Apple TV to follow. If the ESP32 joined Wi-Fi more than ten minutes ago, restart it and submit within ten minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Repair ESP32 authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Hold the ESP32 GPIO0/BOOT button for ten seconds, then release it. Wait for the ESP32 to restart, then submit within ten minutes. This resets only the Home Assistant token.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the ESP32. Check its power and network connection.
error.cannot_pair: The ESP32 did not pair. Restart it and try again within ten minutes.
error.token_reset_required: The ESP32 already has another token. Hold GPIO0/BOOT for ten seconds, release it, wait for the restart, then try again within ten minutes.
error.wrong_device: The host now points to a different ESP32.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the discovered ESP32.
